name: Hgraph
description:
Hgraph connects Claude directly to live blockchain data across networks including Ethereum, Base, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche, BNB Chain, Hedera, and a growing list of others, through a single connector. 

Ask questions in plain English and get real-time, network-specific answers such as account balances, portfolio breakdowns, token supplies and holders, transaction history, NFT activity, DeFi metrics, and network analytics.

Key features:
- One connector, every network — a list_chains tool shows what's live; new chains appear automatically, no reconfiguration
- GraphQL — rich indexed queries over enriched blockchain data
- SQL — direct read-only queries against full network history
- JSON-RPC — live node calls on EVM networks
- Built-in context — the connector teaches Claude each chain's schemas and conventions, so queries work on the first try.

Data is served from Hgraph's own bare-metal infrastructure with real-time updates.

Get started free at app.hgraph.com.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Hgraph to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Hgraph to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.hgraph.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Hgraph MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hgraph provides these MCP tools: graphql, list_chains, load_context, rest, rpc, and sql.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Hgraph?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Hgraph in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Hgraph requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Hgraph is developed by Hgraph, Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
